# ModPatch provenance

ModLaunch invokes the .NET 6 compatibility build from [AnomalyLabsIO/SCPSL-ModPatch](https://github.com/AnomalyLabsIO/SCPSL-ModPatch), forked from [hopperlopip/SCPSL-ModPatch](https://github.com/hopperlopip/SCPSL-ModPatch) (MIT, Copyright 2024 LostFire). The unified `SCPSL ModPatch.exe` supports GUI and command line modes; ModLaunch passes command line arguments to run preparation. It is a Windows x64 single-file application targeting `net6.0-windows` and requires the Windows x64 .NET 6 Desktop Runtime. ModLaunch no longer maintains copies of the patch resolver, method mapper, or offset patches.

`SCPSL.ModPatch.dotnet6.0.zip` contains `SCPSL ModPatch.exe`, `patchinfo.json`, clean launchers, notices, and `bundle.json`. The schema 2 inventory identifies the repository, base commit, working tree status, target framework, runtime version, entry point, exact source-archive name and SHA-256, and individual binary/resource hashes. The source archive is authoritative when the checkout includes unpublished changes; the base commit alone does not represent those changes. Both archives have SHA-256 sidecars enforced during packaging. Runtime validation checks the inventory before invoking ModPatch. These checks detect corruption, not a compromised publisher.

The current binary was downloaded from the public [v3.0.0 release](https://github.com/AnomalyLabsIO/SCPSL-ModPatch/releases/tag/v3.0.0) on 2026-11-01 and verified against its GitHub asset digest. Its exact source archive was obtained from the matching local package export, verified against the published binary's inventory, and checked into `vendor/ModPatch/`.

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `SCPSL.ModPatch.dotnet6.0.zip` | `7E2EEA406EDCA8578D025C6D6D9DEC4159BA6FA91B5D88D6F04D76B456D1119D` |
| `SCPSL.ModPatch.sources.3d32bf3d1831.zip` | `3D32BF3D183112285BD9D9CA83B35E56DD6946F96F9F165269E389C285C8EE12` |

The published inventory records base revision `fe5a437d7d3d9aa80aff3c179006fe295c20a0d1` and `sourceDirty: true`. The matching source archive above is authoritative for the executable's build inputs. Neither that base commit nor the later public commit `fe257a295733c49b7624d78d8225c237e632e8a0`, which includes URL changes, substitutes for this exact snapshot. Runtime pattern resources can use a newer immutable public commit independently of the bundled executable.

`SCPSL.ModPatch.sources.<hash>.zip` contains the corresponding fork source, dependency binaries, manifests, clean launchers, tests, and packaging script. Its filename includes the first 12 hexadecimal characters of its SHA-256. It is available in `vendor/ModPatch/` in the GitHub source archive for each ModLaunch release tag. Rebuild with its `scripts/package.ps1 -Package Compatibility` using PowerShell 7 and a .NET 10 SDK, passing `-SourceRevision` from `bundle.json` when using an exported archive. Refresh the pinned packages using ModLaunch's `scripts/import-modpatch.ps1 -SourceRoot <fork checkout>`.

The integration requests `--metadata-mode preserve --bundle-version-mode correct` and lets ModPatch determine the initial parser configuration from Unity identity, then select the complete target from original DLL hash/version. The CLI reports parser identity, selected profile index, patch outcomes, the bundle-version correction, and before/after hashes. ModLaunch independently verifies the expected changes and requires runtime metadata to remain original. It rejects incomplete results and unsupported manifest syntax before activating any live file. The package must advertise `bundle-version-correction`; older companions fall back to the current bundled engine.

The compatibility build's dependencies include Il2CppDumper and Mono.Cecil from its `SCPSL ModPatch/Il2CppDumper/` directory, Iced 1.21.0, Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3, Newtonsoft.Json.Bson 1.0.2, System.IO.Hashing 8.0.0, and Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client 6.0.0. Original projects: [Il2CppDumper](https://github.com/Perfare/Il2CppDumper) and [Mono.Cecil](https://github.com/jbevain/cecil); both use MIT licenses. Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client uses the Microsoft .NET Library license in `NET_Library_EULA_ENU.txt`. The verified package's `licenses/` tree includes dependency notices and the clean Unity launcher notice. It is retained inside the embedded companion and copied to the full distribution's `third-party-licenses/ModPatch/`. The compatibility package does not include FASM or Unlicense; definitions that need FASM fail explicitly, and CLI mode does not unpack protected game assemblies.

`MetadataHeaderNormalizer.cs` and `MelonInteropAssemblyGenerator.cs` remain GPL-3.0-or-later ModLaunch components for the Cpp2IL/Il2CppInterop preparation path. Runtime metadata is never rewritten. ModPatch owns the Unity bundle-version correction; ModLaunch has no Unity asset rewrite implementation. ModLaunch keeps the original `globalgamemanagers` backup, activates ModPatch's corrected output, and restores the original through its transactional session lifecycle. SL-AC relocation also remains a ModLaunch responsibility.

Cpp2IL `2022.1.0-pre-release.21` and its StrippedCodeRegSupport plugin are fetched from the pinned release; SHA-256 digests from the GitHub release API are embedded in the helper. Unity managed libraries use a Unity-version-specific release and enforce a published digest when available; older releases lack upstream digests, so downloads are cached with a local SHA-256.
